scheme_name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme- For Startups
other_conditions: Startup must be recognized by DPIIT
Incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application
Business idea must aim to develop a product or service with market fit, viable commercialization and scope of scaling
Core product or service (or business/distribution model) must involve the use of technology

Must not have received more than ₹10 Lakhs of monetary support under any other Central or State Government scheme (excluding prize money, subsidised workspace, founder allowance, access to labs or prototyping facilities)
Shareholding by Indian promoters must be at least 51% at the time of application
Startup can avail seed support in the form of grants and debt/convertible debentures each once
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹20 Lakhs in grant and up to ₹50 Lakhs in convertible debenture/debt for proof‑of‑concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and scaling.
